cors.correction: yes; Moodle sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * for Web Service requests, although a deployment proxy, firewall, or web server can remove it

description.correction: Moodle Web Services expose site-specific LMS functions through enabled protocols such as REST. Each site controls its services, functions, and user tokens. Moodle can be self-hosted, hosted on MoodleCloud by Moodle, or hosted by a certified partner or service provider; there is no single global API endpoint.

notes: HTTP 0 is expected because the listed base URL contains a placeholder hostname; the documented site-relative endpoint remains current. Core Moodle explicitly enables CORS. Official sources support free self-hosting but do not document the claimed absence or configurability of API quotas. The description incorrectly excludes MoodleCloud hosting operated by Moodle.
